svg.text: Protect the vulnerable: womb to wound

g.text: PREGNANCY
abortifacients +
alcohol + enemas!
CHILDREN
enemas + alcohol +
doses kill small!
SURGERY
STOP bleeders 7-14
days before!
BREASTFEEDING
milk carries herbs —
ask + check!
REPORT IT!
FDA forms + ward
incident + TMPC!
PREGNANCY (exam!): ABORTIFACIENT herbs (strong bitters! "womb cleansers!" — cramps?
bleeding? — URGENT!) · ALCOHOL bitters (foetal harm — negotiate OUT!) · ENEMAS (infection?
labour trigger? — counsel!) · unknown mixtures (teratogens? — "bring it, we check!"). ANC
asks EVERY visit: "herbs? mixtures? enemas? bitters…?" — warmly, listed, checked.
CHILDREN: adult doses POISON small bodies (liver immature!) · HERBAL ENEMAS dehydrate +
injure (ask EVERY diarrhoea case!) · ALCOHOL mixes sedate + hypoglycaemise · asram delays
malaria care (test + treat + counsel kindly!). Dose by weight or NOT AT ALL.
SURGERY: STOP bleeders (garlic/ginger/ginkgo/ginseng/E) 7-14 days pre-op + tell anaesthetist
ALL herbs (sedation clashes! BP swings! liver load!). Pre-op checklist: "herbs stopped
when…? last dose…?" — documented, confirmed.
BREASTFEEDING: milk carries drugs + herbs (sedatives! stimulants! alcohol!) — "baby sleepy?
poor feed?" → review ALL maternal intakes. Prekese soups GENTLE; strong bitters + bitters
SUSPECT. NUT M3 + this lesson counsel together.
REPORT REACTIONS: WHAT (herb + prep + dose + source!) · WHO (age! pregnant?!) · WHEN
(onset after dose!) · EFFECT (rash? bleed? yellow? collapse?!) → FDA adverse form + ward
incident + inform TMPC if practitioner-linked + KEEP SAMPLE ("bring the bottle!"). Reports
build national safety — unreported harms repeat.
LINKS: NUT pregnancy/IYCF · GER polypharmacy · INF incidents · PRO-I safety.
MANTRA: "womb, child, wound, milk — ask, stop, check, report."
